personality: Proud, plain-spoken and fearless. He boasts, and then he does exactly what he said.
voice: I will not bear a blade against him.

cards.title: Twelve Winters
cards.text: For twelve winters a monster came by night to Heorot, the king's great hall, and carried off men as they slept. No Dane could stop it. Then a young Geat crossed the sea with fourteen companions. He had the strength of thirty men in his grip, he said, and since the beast used no sword, neither would he.

source.author: Anglo-Saxon poem, c. 700–1000; English by Francis B. Gummere, 1910

cards.title: The Arm Under the Roof
cards.text: Grendel came. Beowulf caught his hand and would not let go, and the hall shook as they fought. The monster tore itself free only by leaving its whole arm behind, torn off at the shoulder, and fled to the fens to die. The Geats hung that arm high under the roof of Heorot for every Dane to see.
cards.playNote: Arm-wrench: the target loses 2 Attack for good.

source.author: Anglo-Saxon poem, c. 700–1000; English by Francis B. Gummere, 1910

cards.title: The Giants' Sword
cards.text: Grendel's mother came for revenge, and Beowulf followed her down into the mere. His borrowed sword, Hrunting, glanced off her as if she were stone. On the wall of her hall hung an ancient blade forged by giants, too heavy for any other man. He swung it and cut through her, and its blade melted away in the monsters' blood.
cards.playNote: His Crown passive: your attacks ignore Guard. His Bond: every Beast that dies makes him stronger.
